description: Predicted severity across the real human CBG allelic series: null homozygote, null heterozygote, CBG Lyon and Leuven, compound heterozygote
code:
import numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.integrate import solve_ivp
K_ALB,Vp,CL = 3.4,3.5,25./4.4
KD_WT = 30.0
S0 = CL*10*(1+K_ALB)

def sim(Bmax,Kd,Sf,T=24.,n=16001):
    def g(F): return (1+K_ALB)+Bmax*Kd/(Kd+F)**2
    F0=S0/(CL*(1+K_ALB))
    ts=np.linspace(0,T,n)
    s=solve_ivp(lambda t,y:[(Sf(t)-CL*max(y[0],0)*(1+K_ALB))/(Vp*g(max(y[0],0)))],
                (0,T),[F0],t_eval=ts,rtol=1e-8,atol=1e-10,max_step=0.02)
    F=s.y[0]; return ts,F,F*(1+K_ALB)+Bmax*F/(Kd+F)
def stress(t,t0=.5,dur=.5,mult=6.,tau=.33):
    if t<t0: return S0
    if t<t0+dur: return S0*mult
    return S0*(1+(mult-1)*np.exp(-(t-t0-dur)/tau))
def train(t,period=1.,width=.12,amp=8.):
    ph=t%period; return S0*(1+(amp-1)*np.exp(-.5*((ph-.3)/width)**2))

def occ_ratio(Bmax,Kd,KdR,ref):
    t,F,_=sim(Bmax,Kd,stress); o=F/(KdR+F)
    return np.trapz(o-o[0],t)/ref
tR,Fr,_=sim(700.,KD_WT,stress)
REF={KdR:np.trapz(Fr/(KdR+Fr)-(Fr/(KdR+Fr))[0],tR) for KdR in (0.5,5.0)}

# ---------- the real human allelic series ----------
GEN=[("CBG normal",700.,KD_WT),
     ("null heterozygote (50% CBG)",350.,KD_WT),
     ("Lyon heterozygote",700.,KD_WT*2.5),        # ~half the sites with 4x Kd
     ("Leuven homozygote (3x Kd)",700.,KD_WT*3),
     ("Lyon homozygote (4x Kd)",700.,KD_WT*4),
     ("compound het null/Lyon",350.,KD_WT*4),
     ("null homozygote",0.,KD_WT)]
print(f"{'genotype':30s}{'rest total':>11s}{'tot ratio':>10s}{'free CV':>9s}"
      f"{'CV ratio':>9s}{'MR occ':>8s}{'GR occ':>8s}")
rows=[]
for name,bm,kd in GEN:
    _,_,Tt = sim(bm,kd,stress,T=0.4,n=201); rest=Tt[0]
    ts,F,_ = sim(bm,kd,train); sel=ts>6
    cv=F[sel].std()/F[sel].mean()
    mr,gr = occ_ratio(bm,kd,0.5,REF[0.5]), occ_ratio(bm,kd,5.0,REF[5.0])
    rows.append((name,rest,cv,mr,gr))
print()
r0=rows[0]
for name,rest,cv,mr,gr in rows:
    print(f"{name:30s}{rest:11.0f}{rest/r0[1]:10.2f}{cv:9.3f}{cv/r0[2]:9.2f}{mr:8.3f}{gr:8.3f}")

# ---------- continuous dose-response in CBG capacity ----------
fr=np.linspace(0,1,41)
mr_d=[occ_ratio(700.*f,KD_WT,0.5,REF[0.5]) for f in fr]
gr_d=[occ_ratio(700.*f,KD_WT,5.0,REF[5.0]) for f in fr]
cv_d=[]
for f in fr:
    ts,F,_=sim(700.*f,KD_WT,train); sel=ts>6; cv_d.append(F[sel].std()/F[sel].mean())
i50=np.argmin(abs(fr-0.5))
print(f"\nheterozygote (50% CBG capacity): MR occupancy ratio {mr_d[i50]:.3f}, "
      f"GR {gr_d[i50]:.3f}, free CV ratio {cv_d[i50]/cv_d[-1]:.2f}")
print(f"fraction of the full null MR deficit already present at 50% CBG: "
      f"{(1-mr_d[i50])/(1-mr_d[0]):.2f}")

fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,3,figsize=(15,4.4))
ax[0].plot(fr*100,mr_d,lw=2,color='#1a365d',label='MR (Kd 0.5 nM)')
ax[0].plot(fr*100,gr_d,lw=2,color='#2b6cb0',label='GR (Kd 5 nM)')
ax[0].axvline(50,color='grey',ls=':',lw=1); ax[0].axhline(1,color='grey',ls='--',lw=1)
ax[0].set_xlabel('CBG binding capacity (% of normal)')
ax[0].set_ylabel('stress occupancy-AUC, relative to normal')
ax[0].set_title('Signalling deficit is strongly nonlinear:\nhalf of CBG is nearly enough')
ax[0].legend(frameon=False)
ax[1].plot(fr*100,np.array(cv_d)/cv_d[-1],lw=2,color='#b2283c')
ax[1].axvline(50,color='grey',ls=':',lw=1); ax[1].axhline(1,color='grey',ls='--',lw=1)
ax[1].set_xlabel('CBG binding capacity (% of normal)')
ax[1].set_ylabel('free cortisol CV, relative to normal')
ax[1].set_title('Free cortisol variability rises\nsteeply only below ~40% CBG')
names=[r[0].replace(' (','\n(') for r in rows]; vals=[r[3] for r in rows]
b=ax[2].barh(range(len(rows)),vals,color=['#2b6cb0']+['#7aa5c9']*5+['#b2283c'])
ax[2].set_yticks(range(len(rows))); ax[2].set_yticklabels(names,fontsize=8)
ax[2].invert_yaxis(); ax[2].axvline(1,color='grey',ls='--',lw=1); ax[2].set_xlim(0,1.15)
ax[2].set_xlabel('MR occupancy-AUC, relative to normal')
ax[2].set_title('Predicted severity across the\nhuman allelic series')
for bb,v in zip(b,vals): ax[2].text(v+0.01,bb.get_y()+bb.get_height()/2,f'{v:.2f}',va='center',fontsize=8)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
